name: Lateral Lunge
summary: A side-stepping lunge that trains the legs and glutes in the frontal plane and builds hip mobility.
setup: Stand tall with feet together, hands clasped at your chest.
Brace your abs and look straight ahead.
Make sure you have space to step to the side.
execution: Take a big step to the side with one foot, toes pointing forward.
Push your hips back and bend the stepping knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep the stepping foot flat and your chest up as you lower.
Push through the bent leg to return to the start.
Complete the reps on one side, then switch.
mistakes: Heel of the working foot lifting: sit back into the hips and take a slightly shorter step.
Rounding the back: keep the chest up and reduce depth.
Knee drifting inside the foot: track it in line with the toes.
Toes turning out too far: keep both feet pointing forward.

references.title: Lateral lunge - how to do it right.
